name: Arichal Munai Fish-Fry Shacks
signature_dish: Catch-of-the-day fish fry — masala pomfret and crab — at thatched shacks by the sea
why_it_matters: Dhanushkodi is a ghost-town tip ~20km past Rameswaram with almost no standalone restaurants — what exists is a cluster of thatched-roof fish-fry shacks near Arichal Munai, the land's-end point. They fry the day's catch (pomfret, crab) on the spot and sell tea, tender coconut and cut fruit. Honest scarcity: this is the only real dining at the tip.
insider_tip: Everything except the fish is trucked in from Rameswaram, and drinking water arrives by tanker — so eat the fresh fish fry and carry your own water. The shacks are basic and seasonal; go at lunchtime when the catch is freshest. There is no fine dining at the tip — that is the point of Dhanushkodi.
signature_address: Fish-fry shacks, Arichal Munai, Dhanushkodi, Ramanathapuram District, Tamil Nadu 623526

name: Mr. Fish (Dhanushkodi Road)
area: Dhanushkodi Road, on the way to Dhanushkodi from Rameswaram
signature_dish: Fresh seafood meals — fish, prawn and squid — at a beach shack on the Dhanushkodi road
why_it_matters: A well-rated seafood shack on the beach side of the Dhanushkodi road between Rameswaram and the ghost town — one of the few named, reviewed eateries on the route to Dhanushkodi, serving budget-friendly fresh fish, prawn and squid.
insider_tip: It is on the right side of the Dhanushkodi road, on the beach — an easy stop while driving out to or back from the tip. Fresh catch at budget prices; lunch is the freshest service.
signature_address: Mr. Fish, Dhanushkodi Road, near Rameswaram, Ramanathapuram District, Tamil Nadu 623526

name: Nambu Sanjana Fish Meals (Rameswaram base)
area: Mayanapillai Street, Rameswaram (base for Dhanushkodi trips)
signature_dish: Fish meals — fried fish and fish curry with rice
why_it_matters: A well-rated seafood meals place on Mayanapillai Street in Rameswaram — listed explicitly as a Rameswaram-base option because Dhanushkodi itself has only seasonal shacks. Travellers visiting the ghost-town tip commonly take their proper seafood meal in Rameswaram either side of the drive.
insider_tip: This is in Rameswaram town, not Dhanushkodi — fold it into the start or end of the Dhanushkodi day trip. Go for the fish meals; takeaway is available if you want to carry food toward the tip.
signature_address: Nambu Sanjana Fish Meals, Mayanapillai Street, Rameswaram, Ramanathapuram District, Tamil Nadu 623526
